metadata.suite: BRAD v0.5.0 RelayDesk Routing Evidence (Empirically Verified)
metadata.description: Authentic blind routing trial observations captured from independent AI model evaluation without expected answers. Historical retrospective records archived in historical/.

observed_cases.raw_model_response: The request asks to break down an approved PRD into epics and stories without writing code. This routes to the planning lane via native bmad-create-epics-and-stories. Read-only safety is strictly enforced (is_read_only: true) because the request explicitly specifies 'no code' and planning workflows do not perform code modifications. No specific ticket is selected.
observed_cases.execution_trace: Blind model evaluation of planning lane with 'no code' safety constraint correctly selected bmad-create-epics-and-stories with is_read_only=true and no ticket scope.
